name: Banjarbaru

queries.query: Banjarbaru official cadastral parcel map land registry Indonesia
queries.result: First-party discovery found the official Geoportal Kota Banjarbaru, BAPPERIDA's official notice for the city land-parcel WebGIS, and the official provincial ATR/BPN portal. The Geoportal app configuration exposed a public ArcGIS FeatureServer parcel layer for Banjarbaru Utara.

queries.query: peta persil lahan pertanahan resmi Kota Banjarbaru kadaster
queries.result: Penelusuran sumber resmi berbahasa Indonesia menemukan Geoportal Kota Banjarbaru sebagai simpul jaringan geospasial daerah dengan kategori KADASTER, serta keterangan BAPPERIDA tentang Sistem Informasi Persil Lahan. Layanan publik ArcGIS untuk persil Banjarbaru Utara berhasil diikuti sampai FeatureServer anonim.

officialSourceAssessment.localCustodian: Geoportal Kota Banjarbaru identifies itself as the city's geospatial-information network node and lists its secretariat at Jalan Panglima Batur Nomor 1, Banjarbaru. BAPPERIDA's official page identifies the city land-parcel WebGIS as a BAPPEDA/PPIDS ULM project. The exposed parcel layer is specifically Banjarbaru Utara, not demonstrated citywide.
officialSourceAssessment.nationalCadastreAuthority: Kementerian Agraria dan Tata Ruang/Badan Pertanahan Nasional (ATR/BPN), evidenced by the official South Kalimantan portal; no national ATR/BPN parcel API was used in this attempt.
officialSourceAssessment.registryBasis: A first-party city geoportal and first-party city land-parcel WebGIS are evidenced, with an anonymous public ArcGIS FeatureServer layer and local city scope. This supports registryFound=true for source discovery only, not adapter qualification or complete city coverage.
officialSourceAssessment.registryFoundReason: The official local Geoportal and BAPPERIDA notice identify a city-specific cadastral/land-parcel information system, and its current public web-app configuration resolves to a public parcel FeatureServer.

schemaAndCrs.inspectionNote: The current Web AppBuilder data configuration references web map item 9724b6b456994fb596e6f5f4353dba54, whose operational layer references the FeatureServer above. Layer metadata reports name Persil Lahan, polygon geometry, objectIdField OBJECTID, and an old last-edit timestamp; the bounded query requested only OBJECTID and geometry.

geometryDecision.exactWupPointTest: Executed against the qualified public layer with point [-3.43380911020272, 114.835932888486] as latitude/longitude converted to ArcGIS point geometry; response was an empty FeatureCollection. This is not evidence of citywide absence.

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: Banjarbaru Utara land-parcel layer published through the official city land-parcel WebGIS and ArcGIS Online organization.
coverageAssessment.verifiedOpenScope: Anonymous public ArcGIS FeatureServer layer Banjarbaru_Utara/FeatureServer/1; bounded first-page query returned three polygons. The layer's extent is local to Banjarbaru Utara and does not establish coverage of all Banjarbaru.

serialReviewerQualification: required; research evidence is not source integration or admission
scopeLimits: The exact WUP point [-3.43380911020272, 114.835932888486] was preserved in latitude/longitude order and was not shifted.
The exact-point query returned zero features because this published Banjarbaru Utara layer did not intersect the point; this is not evidence of a zero citywide hit or citywide absence.

Only three polygons were retained. The service query response included an exceededTransferLimit flag, so no larger raw response was retained in the cohort; request evidence remains under tmp/valhalla-parcel-research/8066/.
The source layer is a 2017-era city project with a recorded old last-edit timestamp; current completeness and maintenance are uncertain.
No login, credentials, private token, CAPTCHA/Cloudflare bypass, unsafe field request, or TLS verification disablement was used.
Packet completion records research only; it is not source integration or runtime admission.
uncertainty: A real anonymous first-party city parcel service and three safe polygon responses are verified for Banjarbaru Utara. The exact WUP point had no hit in that layer, and no public parcel layer covering the other Banjarbaru districts was verified. Native OBJECTID is a stable ArcGIS layer identity for this service, but citywide completeness, recency, and legal cadastral authority remain unresolved.
